name: Tokyo

metrics.honesty: Response = predicted drive + station turnout (LFB attendance is mobilise->arrive; travel-only scoring was wrong). Judged on LFB first-engine KPIs: mean <= 6 min, > 90% within 10 min. Drive comes from the chosen scorer (kolesar). Turnout: default (existing stations), 60 s for new sites. Discrete candidates (existing houses + demand centroids); house sites are OpenStreetMap station buildings. No land, zoning or staffing constraints. Station size (n_pumps) defaults from LFB two-pump inference (~40 stations with a second appliance). resize mode reallocates a fixed pump budget under a capacity-scaled busy model; other modes keep baseline pumps unless overridden. Busy blend applies when use_busy=True or mode=resize (location optimisation still uses nearest engine).

caveat: Population-proxy demand + Kolesar travel times; not validated on local fire records.
